The '''Almakar system''' was located in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|When a player asks for a particular piece of information ('How many planets are there in the Almakar system?'), use the following to determine the difficulty number ''[&hellip;]''<nowiki />|Rulebook of the first edition of ''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game''|<ref name="TRPG1">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>}}
[[File:Almakar-Voyages13.png|thumb|right|250px|The noncanonical article "Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are" placed the Almakar system in the Almakar sector.]]
The Almakar [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[1987]] [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|rulebook]] for the first edition of [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. Within the book, it is used in an example question that a player of the [[Roleplaying game|game]] might ask the gamemaster player, who then has to determine the difficulty for the other player's character of obtaining an answer to the question. The hypothetical question concerns the number of [[Planet/Legends|planets]] in the system.<ref name="TRPG1" />

"[[Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are]]," a [[1990]] roleplaying game source article published in [[Voyages SF 13|''Voyages SF'' 13]], placed the Almakar system in the [[Almakar sector]].<ref name="Twinkle">{{VoyagesCite|13|Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are}}</ref> The article is considered [[Canon|noncanonical]] with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="Unlicensed">{{UnlicensedStatus}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the system in grid square N-9.<ref name="TEA" />
